fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on local crime and gambling connected to Hialeah Park and a critique of a purported "Crime Commission"; a major piece attacking the Miami Salvation Army’s charitable practices using the case of blind itinerant Ira Corwin and referencing assistance from the Lighthouse for the Blind; discussion of Florida politics and public-utility policy involving Gov. Warren and the Florida Power & Light Company; coverage of national health legislation debates (including Sen. Pepper) and reporting on patent-medicine and drug-industry lobbying and advertising claims; plus local court/police notes, taxation commentary, and extensive entertainment and nightclub advertising.
